calibration_intro: No printer aligns both sides perfectly: flipping the sheet drifts by half a millimetre to three. This wizard measures that drift and turns it into the two values the PDF Studio needs.
calibration_flip_hint: Pick the same one you use for the cards: it determines which axis the back is mirrored on, and getting it wrong flips the sign of the correction.
calibration_print_1: Print double-sided at 100% scale, with no fit-to-page.
calibration_print_2: Use the same paper you'll use for the cards.
calibration_print_3: Hold the sheet up to the light, front side towards you.
calibration_measure_intro: Against the light you'll see two overlapping crosshairs: the front one (solid) and the back one (dashed). Use the millimetre rulers to read how far apart they are.
calibration_sign_hint: Right and up are positive. If the dashed crosshair sits 2 mm to the right, enter 2. If it sits 2 mm to the left, enter -2.
calibration_where_to_apply: Copy these two values into PDF Studio → Duplex → Back offset. They're saved per deck.
calibration_already_aligned: Your printer is already aligned: no correction needed.
calibration_offset_suspicious: A drift over a centimetre isn't normal miscalibration. Check that you measured from the centre and that the paper feeds straight.
calibration_second_pass: To verify, apply the values, print this same sheet again and check whether the crosshairs now line up. If there's still drift, repeat with the new measurement.

settings_drive_step2b: Or in the editor: select the card → + Add by URL with the direct URL.
